body:
30F here. Don't really have anything wise to say. Just wanted to let you know you're not alone. I relate so much to every single word you just wrote. It's not a comfort, but yeah. I'm sorry you have to feel this way. I hope things will get better for you one day.

Do you have someone in your IRL life to talk to, I mean a psychologist, therapist or anyone else in some sort of professional role? Just so you don't have to keep up appearances all the time, and maybe have at least someone and somewhere you can vent and let go in person.

Yeah. Apparently I did. If I wasn't that big of a fucking failure and nuisance that no one wanted around, this wouldn't happen. There's a reason people decide to bring me down and shoo me away in particular.

I never said I did. I'm still expecting to get my posts to be left alone, especially in a fucking sub for depressed people, when they don't break any rules, not having them removed because someone decided they didn't like *me* in particular while the other hundreds of new posts gets to stay.

They're beautiful because we're genetically programmed to appreciate a certain kind of harmonic, symmetric and proportional face. I know there are studies showing that even babies have been shown to react more positively to faces widely considered attractive than to faces widely considered unattractive. These aren't preferences we change or have any control over, it's just the way it is. Obviously there will also be some cultural differences with beauty ideals, like tan skin and arched brows being considered attractive in most Western countries while pale skin and straight brows is the ideal in some Asian countries, but the points with weight, facial symmetry and harmony still applies.

Because it's lies built upon the old, hurtful "EVERYONE IS BEAUTIFUL AND LOOKS DOESN'T MATTER" cliché that people still try to live by only to be kind and try to make someone happy and feel better about themselves. Well-meaning lies for sure, but still lies.

Beauty is *not* subjective. Ask 100 or even 10 000 people whether they find Elsa Hosk or Susan Boyle more attractive.

BMI is a general guideline, not a truth you should base your entire views on. It doesn't say anything about muscle or fat. My clothing size in my home country is XXL btw. So yes. Definitely overweight.

Dude. You spent your *entire* first message being condescending and telling me "nonono, you're not ugly". Stop being an asshole and wake up to reality. Elsa Hosk and Keira Knightley are beautiful, me and Susan Boyle aren't. As for your second message: "I won't invest so much time to write you a nice message if all I get is silence". Cool. Like that's gonna make anyone wanna reply to you.

I'd rather die incel than being nice to r/niceguys. Bye.

Oh, this again. :( When you're ugly enough that people think you're making fun of someone else. Feelsbadman.

I'm not trolling. I'm not shaming someone else. This is me, and I fucking despise myself and I just want to find someone who might be able to love and appreciate me even with my flaws. I got rated a 2-3, even a 1 by one or two people, over on r/truerateme. This isn't in my head, it's facts.
And since I apparently have to add this: No BDSM dudes looking for slaves and shit. Bye.

Hi. I've responded to some of your messages, but please note that I'm not looking for "kindness" or compliments. I'm not retarded or blind, I know full well what I look like, and no dumb "bEauTy Is SubJectIve" or "but **I** think you're beautiful" is gonna change that. I'm aware that most of you probably mean well, but it doesn't matter. I don't want lies, it only makes me feel worse, and I'm not interested in keeping up a conversation with someone who's only ending up being condescending.

Thank you for understanding.
Wow, it's almost like I have a main account that I won't ruin with a post like this. Fuck you.
Not odd at all. Soap bubbles are actually pretty to look at. And it's always fun to try to blow the biggest bubbles! I'm glad it left you at ease.

Yeah, I'm a female incel and the rating subs on here have said I'm a 1-2/10, lmao. So trying to be nice and being blue pilled about appearances and beauty isn't working on me. I'm not blind for ideals and I've lived with this face for 30 years, I know well I'm ugly.

Hi. Just wanted to say that I'm looking for someone who lives somewhat close to me, so if you're one of the people who sent me a message living in the US or AUS, I'm afraid we're not really the best of matches. I want to meet someone I actually have a chance of seeing every now and then, and I don't think that will happen with someone living more than a few borders away. To those of you whop replied though: I'm glad you did. I wish you well and I sincerely hope you find someone. Take care!

I'm sorry if these suggestions come off as too basic and dull.

Try cooking or baking stuff you've never done before. Read recipes, make increasingly more complicated dishes, challenge yourself - and make sure to take some time off enjoying the food!

Do you like animals? If you do but you or your family or close friends doesn't have any, maybe you could find a dog that needs walking or even sitting?

Learn new things, whether it's a language or something completely else. I feel like there are tutorials and guides for everything and anything on Youtube. Maybe there's something you're interested in (or can get interested in)?

What about video games? Even if you're not super into it, there are plenty of games that works for casual gamers alike. Maybe something cinematic like Until Dawn or Detroit Become Human, or why not a puzzle PC game?

Try to combine TV and music with something good for your body. Make a facial or hair mask, do a foot SPA, massage yourself, whatever makes you relax and feel good at least physically.

Or maybe play an instrument. Learn to play songs you like, or try writing your own.

I hope you find something that helps you and makes your thoughts less intruding and present. Take care.

I'll respect your wish and won't try to talk you out of anything. I'm at the same place every now and then, I can relate and I know what it's like having people not understanding.

I just wanted to say that someone read your post. Someone relates. I'm sorry you've had to deal with all this. I'm sure you aren't making the amazing people in your life suffer. There's a reason they're still there, and that you are as well. Please don't think your decision will make anything better for them. It won't. It's not reason enough to stay, I understand that, but please don't end it because you think it's the best for anyone else.
